techniques.name: Exploding-Tag Kunai
techniques.mechanic: With a paper bomb in the pouch, the throw key on a kunai throws it tagged: it sticks, then bursts (radius 3, fuse 20) or on Ram
techniques.counters: knock the kunai down; substitution; wind blows it off course

techniques.name: Shadow Shuriken
techniques.mechanic: Throw one shuriken with a second hidden in its shadow: a dodge of the first meets the second
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles

techniques.name: Manipulated Shuriken
techniques.mechanic: Shuriken on chakra threads: up to five curve to the target around cover (homing 0.4)
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles

techniques.name: Windmill Triple Attack
techniques.mechanic: Three windmill shuriken on wire: they wrap and bind the target (bound 60 ticks), then fire can run the wires
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles

techniques.name: Wind-Channelled Shuriken
techniques.mechanic: Wind chakra on a thrown shuriken: double damage, pierces two targets, range 32
techniques.counters: fire jutsu (fire beats and swallows wind), an earth wall, a heavy stance (poise)
techniques.note: Weapon-plus-jutsu combo: scales with both the weapons and ninjutsu pillars (the average)

techniques.name: Lightning Flow Blade
techniques.mechanic: Lightning in the held blade for 200 ticks: every hit shocks (4 ticks) and reach +0.5
techniques.counters: wind jutsu (wind beats lightning), break line of sight, dodge on the charge

techniques.name: Fire Flow Blade
techniques.mechanic: Fire in the held blade for 200 ticks: every hit sets alight
techniques.counters: water jutsu (water beats fire), an earth or water wall, sidestep the slow projectile

techniques.name: Wind Flow Blade
techniques.mechanic: Wind in the held blade for 200 ticks: reach +1.5 and armour pierce 0.5
techniques.counters: fire jutsu (fire beats and swallows wind), an earth wall, a heavy stance (poise)

techniques.name: Earth Flow Blade
techniques.mechanic: Earth in the held weapon for 200 ticks: poise damage x2
techniques.counters: lightning jutsu (lightning beats earth), jump the ground wave, flank the wall

techniques.name: Water Flow Blade
techniques.mechanic: Water on the held weapon for 200 ticks: soaked on hit and knockback +1
techniques.counters: earth jutsu (earth beats water), stay away from water (water jutsu cost more far from it)

techniques.name: Explosive Kunai Barrage
techniques.mechanic: Throw six tagged kunai in a fan; they burst together on Ram
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles

techniques.name: Rising Twin Dragons
techniques.mechanic: Two storage scrolls spiral up around you and you rain their weapons down (30 projectiles over 40 ticks)
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles

techniques.name: Shuriken Shadow Clone
techniques.mechanic: One thrown shuriken becomes a storm of up to 40 real copies
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles
